run_concat_mla_k: run the concat_mla_k kernel to concatenate k_nope and k_rope tensors into k for MLA attention
run_concat_mla_absorb_q: run the concat_mla_absorb_q kernel to concatenate two tensors a and b for MLA absorbed Q computation
load_jit_concat_mla_k_module: load the JIT-compiled concat_mla_k CUDA module with elementwise/concat_mla.cuh kernel
load_jit_concat_mla_absorb_q_module: load the JIT-compiled concat_mla_absorb_q CUDA module with elementwise/concat_mla.cuh kernel
test_concat_mla_kernels: test the concat_mla_k and concat_mla_absorb_q kernels with bfloat16 tensors for MLA attention
